title: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie found guilty over 191 starvation deaths
summary: Preacher Paul Mackenzie is accused of telling his followers to starve themselves to death. He ran a Christian doomsday cult called the Good News International Church that claimed the end of the world…

image.caption: Mackenzie was arrested in 2023 [FILE: February 6, 2026]Image: Halima Gongo/DW

blocks.text: A court in Mombasa, Kenya on Monday convicted cult leader Paul Mackenzie of murdering 190 children and one adult. His sentencing will take place on November 6.
This is a breaking news story and will be updated...
